user.title: ISP Health Monitor Setup
user.description:
Simple ISP health monitoring that tracks your internet connection quality and speed. All features work without API keys using free services.

**What it monitors:**
• Your public IP address and location
• DNS server configuration
• Network latency (ping times)
• Internet speed (optional)

**Rate Limits:**
• ip-api.com: 45 requests/minute (free)
• ipinfo.io: 50,000 requests/month (free), unlimited with token
